# `company.item_conversions`

Items converted to inventory parts: the type they were, and the first day they carry stock.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this conversion. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | items.id | Item that was converted; it keeps its id, so every document still names it. |
| `from_type` | VARCHAR(24) | no | — | — | — | — | Item type before the conversion: non_inventory_part or other_charge. |
| `to_type` | VARCHAR(24) | no | — | — | — | — | Item type after the conversion: inventory_part. |
| `effective_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | First ISO date the item carries stock; no stock moves before it. |
| `reason` | VARCHAR(140) | no | — | — | — | — | Why the item was converted, as the person gave it. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp of the conversion. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal who converted the item. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface the conversion came through. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event of the conversion. |
